performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but spend collapse threatens August prove-it volume.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — scoreboard integrity broken.
CPL dropped 38.43% week-over-week to ~$11.46 as spend fell 40.42% — efficiency gain is real but driven by budget cuts, not structural improvement.
3-day lead signal (Aug 16–18: 3+8+5=16 leads) vs prior 3 days (Aug 13–15: 4+1+1=6 leads) shows a sharp recovery — last 3 days are 2.7× the prior 3.
GHL pipeline shows 83 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — 125 leads arriving but no pipeline conversion recorded is an intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell 32.08% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 16–18) show 1+0+0 actions — organic local visibility deteriorating while paid pulls back.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% (~$7/day from $35.95/day) — CPL confirmed at $11.46 with 3-day lead recovery of 2.7×.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL dropped 38.43% week-over-week to $11.46 while the last 3 days (Aug 16–18) produced 16 leads vs 6 in the prior 3 days — a confirmed 2.7× recovery. Raise the Meta daily budget by +20% (approximately $7/day on the current $35.95/day pace) on the BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign. Success check: CPL stays at or below $13 and leads hold above 5/day for 3 consecutive days by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 125 leads, 83 opps created, 0 appointments — fix pipeline stage mapping or contact Lily sync review immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 83 opportunities created from 125 leads over 28 days but zero appointments and zero won — this means leads are arriving but not advancing through the pipeline, which directly breaks the August scoreboard. Ahmed Memon / Ali Shaheer to audit pipeline stage triggers and Lily's intake workflow with the new hire onboarding. Success check: at least 1 confirmed appointment recorded in GHL by 2026-08-22, confirming the stage-advance trigger is working.

suggestions.text: Unblock phone-match attribution gap (overdue 2026-08-07) — without it, lead-to-patient tracking is blind for August prove-it month.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution milestone was due 2026-08-07 and remains unresolved, meaning inbound calls cannot be matched to ad source — a direct gap in the client's scoreboard of leads → schedules → shows → patients. Attribution team to deliver the phone-match fix by 2026-08-21. Success check: at least one inbound call correctly attributed to a Meta or GBP source in GHL by end of day 2026-08-21.
